_about: George McCall Theal's collection of Xhosa folk tales, printed under the title Kaffir Folk-lore (London: Swan Sonnenschein, 1886); the title is the book's own and uses a term now recognised as a slur. His histories are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
